sara: Heads up — Acme submitted a GDPR deletion request 2026-03-15T22:10Z. Our erase API returned 200 (accepted) but customer reports embeddings still visible in search. request_id=req_0a1b2c3d prod-eu-1.
ben: can you paste original response + any erase_audit_id and storage log lines?
sara: attaching curl + response snippet.
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/acme/erase" -d '{"scope":"all","actor":"support@sara@redwood"}' -H 'Idempotency-Key: delete-20260315-acme'
```
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{"status":"accepted","erase_audit_id":"ea-20260315-77"}
```
ben: got it. any tombstone write lines from storage?
sara: logs snippet below (redacted):
[2026-03-15T22:10:12Z] delete-handler INFO tombstone written tenant=acme key=embeddings/sha256:abc123 audit=ea-20260315-77
[2026-03-15T22:10:13Z] kms-client WARN retry-loop status=403 key=eu/kms/key-1 req=req_0a1b2c3d
[2026-03-15T22:10:17Z] rewrap-queue INFO queued job_id=job-987 backlog=68
deploy-bot: rotator v2 deployed by pipeline #452 at 2026-03-15T22:08:59Z
oleg: FYI we performed a KMS rotate in prod-eu-1 at ~22:09 UTC. Rewrap worker pool hit concurrency limits and some rewrap calls returned transient 403/429. That left parts of the delete flow in a pending-rewrap state; audit-store marked pending vs completed until rewrap finished.
ashley-legal: customer will require a DPA proof bundle: tombstone log lines, KMS operation ids, and the index/sweep completion timestamp. Please include precise UTC times.
emma-cs: Acme expects confirmation of full deletion within 48h; they're pushing for proof of EU residency handling.
ben: quick repro note — if cache/index reconciliation lags after tombstone write, search can still return vectors for a short window. Could be index lag not erase failure.
sara: repro steps for ops to collect evidence and force resolution:
1) fetch audit ea-20260315-77 from audit-store
2) check rewrap job status: `curl -u :$TOKEN https://internal-api/rewrap/job/job-987`
3) list KMS ops since 2026-03-15T22:00Z: `kc ops --since 2026-03-15T22:00:00Z --key eu/kms/key-1`
oleg: checked job-987: state=queued -> running -> success at 2026-03-15T22:12:26Z. KMS op ids observed: op-555, op-556. Rewrap finished but the index reconciliation (sweep) was delayed because the sweep worker experienced an elevated PG replication lag for ~3m.
sara: so root cause appears to be: scheduled KMS rotate + transient rewrap backlog + index reconciliation lag = DPA timeline mismatch where API accepted deletion but search returned stale embeddings for ~3 minutes.
ashley-legal: that sequence is acceptable provided we produce the complete bundle of evidence showing tombstone write timestamp (22:10:12Z), KMS ops (op-555/op-556), and sweep/index update timestamp (22:13:45Z). We'll use that for the customer's DPA audit.
emma-cs: I'll notify Acme: we have a technical explanation and will provide the audit bundle within 2 hours. Setting customer expectation: confirmation in 2h.
sara: action items: (A) assemble audit bundle: tombstone log lines, rewrap job output, KMS op ids, sweep logs and index update timestamp; (B) run forced index resync for tenant=acme and confirm zero embeddings returned; (C) draft response to customer with timeline + apologetic note. Assigning @oleg for ops logs and @ben for index resync.
ben: acknowledged — running resync now.
ben: resync complete — search query returns no embeddings for tenant=acme. Sweep finished at 2026-03-15T22:13:45Z.
sara: thanks. I'll collate logs and hand to @ashley-legal for DPA evidence package. Opening support ticket SUP-3219 and will DM the customer with timeline. Closing thread once legal signs off on bundle.
